extracted.intended_audience: startup founders, startup PR/marketing teams, and VC/agency communicators preparing funding announcement press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and distributing press releases that announce startup funding rounds (seed through series rounds), aimed at maximizing media pickup, investor credibility, recruiting, and customer awareness. Covers headline and lede composition, body content (use of funds, traction, investor details, quotes), distribution channels, and an implicit checklist of required elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of Funding Announcement
rubrics_metrics.description: Notify audiences about new VC, angel, or grant funding; make stakeholders aware; raise media interest; build credibility with future investors and customers; recruit talent; attract customers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists the primary goals the press release should achieve; use these goals to shape emphasis and distribution strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline
rubrics_metrics.description: Short; sum up who and what; lead with startup name; include amount of funding; active verbs (raises, secures, closes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided: 'Acme Raises $50M Series B Led by Sequoia'. Keep headline concise and front-load the company name and funding amount using active verbs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lede / Opening Paragraph
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer three questions: WHO (company), WHAT (funding round and amount), WHY (purpose/use of funds).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optionally include WHEN, WHERE, and a brief company description. The lede should quickly communicate the core facts so journalists can understand relevance immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Funds (body content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain how the funds will be used: product roadmap, market expansion, talent acquisition, other initiatives; specify milestones to be funded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be concrete about initiatives and specific milestones to make the announcement informative and newsworthy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company Traction (body content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include user adoption metrics, revenue figures, customer growth, notable customers, geographic reach, and other meaningful milestones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide measurable and notable indicators of momentum so reporters and investors can assess progress and credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor Information (body content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Name lead investor (named first), list all participating VCs, angel investors, strategic investors, and any existing investors that participated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify investor roles (lead vs. participants) and surface recognizable investor names to build credibility; coordinate naming with investors to confirm accuracy and approvals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor Quote
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a quote from an investor explaining why they invested, the market opportunity, and founder/team strengths.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investor quotes should communicate endorsement and rationale; ensure quotes are attributed and approved by investor PR as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Founder/CEO Quote
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a quote describing the vision for use of funds, mission statement, and appreciation for the team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Founder quotes should articulate strategic intent and express momentum—use clear language about how the funding advances the company's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute via PR Newswire, Business Wire, Prowly; send direct to tech press (TechCrunch, etc.); coordinate with VC firm PR; consider embargo if multi-VC announcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan distribution channels and timing in coordination with investors and select outlets; use embargoes strategically for coordinated coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding amount stated upfront
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed in the 'Implicit Quality Rubric for Funding Announcements' as a core element—ensure amount is clear in headline or lede.

rubrics_metrics.name: Round specified
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the round type to provide context about company lifecycle and investor expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead investor named
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name the lead investor explicitly and place them prominently in the investor section and possibly the headline if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: All participating investors named
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include participating VCs, angels, and strategic investors; confirm participation and spelling with investors before release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of funds specified concretely
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid vague statements—provide specific initiatives or milestones that the funding will support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company traction metrics included
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide measurable indicators (users, revenue, customers, geographic reach) that demonstrate momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Founder + investor quotes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include at least one founder/CEO quote and one investor quote to provide narrative and external validation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic context (why this round, why now)
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategic context (why this round, why now).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the rationale for the timing and strategy behind the raise to make the announcement meaningful beyond the dollar figure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total funding to date noted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cumulative funding information to give readers a sense of scale and runway.

rubrics_metrics.name: Valuation disclosed (if applicable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include valuation only if the company and investors have agreed to disclose it—otherwise omit to avoid inaccuracies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer/product highlights
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Spotlight notable customers, product milestones, or use cases that illustrate traction and market fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hiring plans
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mention planned talent acquisition areas if recruiting is a goal of the announcement; link to careers or contact where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press contact at company AND VC
rubrics_metrics.description: Press contact at company AND VC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide PR contact information for both the company and the lead/participating VC(s) to facilitate reporter follow-ups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo and headshots
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include high-resolution assets (company logo, founder headshots) to help media use correct branding and images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demo/product URL
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply a link to product demo or website so reporters and potential customers can immediately evaluate the product.
